title: Single-ring first Tor connecting map with ideal-kernel image and explicit cycle formula
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, I an ideal, M an R-module, P a projective resolution of M whose terms are free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and μ : I ⊗_R M → M an R-linear map satisfying μ(a ⊗ x)=a x. With first Tor as in [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], there exists an injective R-linear δ : Tor_1^R(M,R/I) → I ⊗_R M with range ker μ. For every degree-one cycle z of P ⊗ R/I, every lift y ∈ P_1 satisfying iCycles(z)=y ⊗ 1, and every finite expression d_1(y)=Σ_j a_j p_j with a_j ∈ I and p_j ∈ P_0, δ((P.isoLeftDerivedObj).inv(homologyπ(z)))=Σ_j a_j ⊗ ε(p_j). The formula is universal in the lift and the finite expression.

source.place: Parent ideal-kernel naturality node, Steps 1–3; Stacks Algebra, proof of Tag 00M5 and Remark 00M6 (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00M6).

proof.text: Construct delta_H on the homology of P tensor R/I with the finite-expression formula.
Apply homology exactness to this map and its formula to get injectivity and range ker mu.

Compose delta_H with the hom of P.isoLeftDerivedObj. Its hom is bijective, so composition preserves injectivity and the range. For a cycle class supplied using the inverse of this same isomorphism, cancel hom after inv and apply the homology formula.

theorem exists_tor_ideal_connecting_formula
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (hP : ∀ n : ℕ, Module.Free R (P.complex.X n))
    (μR : (I ⊗[R] M) →ₗ[R] M)
    (hμR : ∀ (a : I) (x : M), μR (a ⊗ₜ[R] x) = (a : R) • x) :
    ∃ δR : (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).obj M).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I)))
      →ₗ[R] (I ⊗[R] M),
      Function.Injective δR ∧ LinearMap.range δR = LinearMap.ker μR ∧
      (∀ (z : ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸
        I))).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).cycles 1)
        (y : P.complex.X 1) (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → I) (p : Fin k → P.complex.X 0),
        ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).iCycles 1 z = y ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R ⧸ I) →
        P.complex.d 1 0 y = ∑ j, (a j : R) • p j →
        δR ((P.isoLeftDerivedObj ((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I)))
          1).inv (((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸
          I))).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).homologyπ 1 z)) =
          ∑ j, a j ⊗ₜ[R] P.π.f 0 (p j))
